items.title: Upwork (UPWK) Stock Faces Mixed Analyst Target Changes As Profitability Improves
items.summary: Upwork’s updated fair value estimate has shifted to about US$10.64 from US$9.88, signaling a recalibration of expectations around the stock. Recent analyst commentary points to a mix of higher confidence in profitability and concern about softer client and revenue trends, which has led to price targets moving in both directions over the past few months. items.title: Big Investors Now Doubt Anthropic Can IPO at $1.5 Trillion After the AI Crash
items.summary: Anthropic's record-setting IPO was supposed to be a victory lap, but three investors are quietly pushing back on price while one blank line in the filing worries them even more. Who absorbs the hit if the deal shrinks or slips?
